integration: Both checked source paths are integrated in canonical; no additional build/run during packaging.

actual.scope: generated full-source fused gate/up halves, strict SF import, selected-bank map and old-reader lifetime; no original publisher values

checks.numerical: Non-FP4 BF16 activation values remain unchanged. Signed E2M1 times imported E8 scales is rounded to BF16 W; a two-term F64 sum is rounded to the expected BF16 endpoint. Independent GRS-RNE examples assert 1.25->E8(1) and 1.5->E8(2).
cold_rejection: Invalid up-SF after gate conversion returns no prepared Source or new generation; no clamp
checks.lifetime: Two bound generations hold 10 bank blocks; a third upload is rejected. Dropping batches preserves 10 Invocation-held blocks, dropping Invocations retires all 10, and independent old result leases remain readable after compiled graph release.
checks.strict: One existing CPU test TU with MSVC /W4 /WX and sourceDependencies; cached original CPU core/native closure.

reader.meaning: The original loaded fused W/SF is split along full dim0 into contiguous halves, before this finite per-half prefix is selected.
reader.numerical_reference: Unchanged positive-finite F32 to E8M0 GRS RNE importer, then BF16 weight-only reader; no producer-OAS or native reduction equivalence.

limits: This is each original half first N3 rows/full K8192, not the full fused bank, complete FFN/down/router, complete Model, or generation.
